scope: Palette ranges: the tables read by 80:999A (8C:F624 + 32 n, 30 bytes) and 81:A919 (8D:F1BA + 16 n, 30 bytes) from their first block. The first table ends before the first word with bit 15 set (8C:FF62); the second ends at 8D:FB78, where the OBJ data that 80:C06B sends to VRAM begins (analysis/rom-vram.json). Plus the other ROM ranges sent by DMA straight to CGRAM in all live tests. Overlaps merged.
